name: agentic-browser-node
description: Autonomous browser automation system with a 3-agent feedback loop (Planner, Browser, Critique) in Node.js, Express, and SQLite.

scripts.test:browser: node -e "import('playwright').then(async ({ chromium }) => { console.log('Popping up browser...'); const b = await chromium.launch({ headless: false }); const p = await b.newPage(); await p.goto('https://news.ycombinator.com'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 6000)); await b.close(); console.log('Closed.'); })"
